name: Gaol-Queen Marga

Traits.name: Shackled Thralls
Traits.text: If Marga dies, it returns to life in 1d4 days and regains all its Hit Points unless the shackles are struck from the corpse.

Traits.name: Aura of Authority
Traits.text: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from Marga, Marga and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided Marga doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: Marga makes three attacks, using Cudgel or Shackle Flail in any combination. It can replace one attack with a use of Condemning Curse.

Actions.name: Cudgel
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 5 ft. 33 (11d4 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.name: Shackle Flail
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +11, reach 5 ft. 33 (6d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage.

Actions.name: Condemning Curse
Actions.text: *Dexterity Saving Throw:* DC 19, one creature within 60 feet. *Failure:* The target is cursed until the end of Marga's next turn. The first time the cursed target deals damage to any creature before then, it takes 32 (5d12) Necrotic damage. *Success:* Half damage only.

lore: A jailer who outlived her prison's descent into an iron gaol-tomb, she binds each new inmate's sentence to her own survival and holds court in the cellblock she now rules, wanting only to remain the one who never wears the chains.

generation.userConcept: a gaol-queen whose prisoners fight for her while she watches from behind them
